title: Agnes and the disputed will (paraphrase)
topic: A notary settles an inheritance dispute: Agnes keeps a farmer's will, the son demands the whole farm, the daughter cites the statute that grants each child half, the son's appeal fails, Agnes summons both heirs to a final meeting

D.subj: Der letzte Wille eines alten Landwirts

tail_E: The settlement is ready, so Agnes hands both heirs a pen to

notes: Formulation B, domain law: independent re-phrasing of the ten meaning units of F18A in both languages (same events, same order, same name Agnes). The will is 'last will' / 'letzter Wille', the office 'Kanzlei', the farmer 'Landwirt'; unit 8 renders the appeal as 'takes the matter to the regional court' / 'bringt die Sache vor das Landgericht' and unit 9 the dismissal as 'rules against the son' / 'entscheidet gegen den Sohn'. Unit 6 has the idiomatic manner adjunct 'in aller Ruhe'. No separable verbs ('anfechten', 'abweisen', 'zusammenbringen' avoided). Subjects vary between the protagonist, other people, the court, the will and the law itself. Unit 9 reads naturally in German, units 1 and 10 in English.
